response.backstory: Eleanor Morales is 79 and lives in Maricopa County, Arizona, with a steady middle income that supports her routine expenses but leaves her attentive to premium changes. She feels well served by her current Medicare Advantage plan and longtime clinicians, so she is slow to consider switching unless coverage changes significantly. As she pays more attention to mobility, preventive care, and staying independent, she values dependable access, familiar providers, and practical supplemental benefits. She will compare costs, but peace of mind and continuity of care matter most.
